u0: No outstanding requirement is pending here: either the ball is in the way of the door, or the agent is currently carrying the matching key. The overall mission of picking up the designated target box remains, along with any other steps it needs. If the ball is out of the way while the key is not held, the state moves to a pending-requirement condition instead of staying here.
u1: The ball is out of the way of the door but the agent is not currently carrying the matching key, so later acquisition of that key is now required. This outstanding requirement is resolved as soon as the matching key is picked up, returning to the satisfied condition; no other obligations are lifted until then. Waiting here without getting the key keeps the requirement open, and picking up a non-matching object does not clear it.
